events.evidence: Conflict in Iraq: At least 29 people, including 3 US Marines, are killed by opponents to the interim government and the occupying forces
Prime Minister Zurab Zhvania of Georgia dies of gas poisoning
King Gyanendra of Nepal includes media censorship as part of the emergency measures he has declared

label.note: Iraq casualties, Georgian PM death, and Nepal emergency measures increase political risk, but no macro shock.
